name: 光照累积量（每日光积分DLI）计算

map.光照累积量（每日光积分DLI）计算是做什么的？: What does Daily Light Integral (DLI) Calculator do?
map.如何使用光照累积量（每日光积分DLI）计算？: How do I use Daily Light Integral (DLI) Calculator?
map.光照累积量（每日光积分DLI）计算适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Daily Light Integral (DLI) Calculator best for?
map.PAR 单位 μmol/m²/s；3.6÷1000 为 μmol→mol 的小时: PAR unit μmol/m²/s; 3.6/1000 converts μmol to mol over an hour integral.
DLI (mol/m²/day) = PAR x light hours (h) x 3.6 / 1000
map.根据光合有效辐射 PAR 与每日光照时长，计算每日光积分 DLI。: Compute DLI from photosynthetically active radiation (PAR) and daily light hours.
map.💡 公式：DLI (mol/m²/日) = PAR × 光照时长 × 3.6 ÷: 💡 Formula: DLI (mol/m²/day) = PAR x light hours x 3.6 / 1000
map.PAR 可通过光合有效辐射计或补光灯说明书获取: PAR from a PAR meter or grow-light manual
map.自然光下晴天正午 PAR 常达 1000–1500 μmol/m²/s，阴天约: Under natural light, sunny noon PAR often 1000-1500, cloudy ~100-300
map.DLI 单位也可写作 mol·m⁻²·d⁻¹，常用于温室作物光环境管理: DLI unit also written mol·m⁻²·d⁻¹, used in greenhouse light management
map.DLI = PPFD × 光照时长 × 3600 / 1,000,000（mol: DLI = PPFD x light hours x 3600 / 1,000,000 (mol/m²/d).
map.用于温室补光设计：多数果蔬苗期 DLI 需求 12~20 mol/m²/d。: Used for greenhouse supplemental lighting: most vegetable/fruit seedlings need 12-20 mol/m²/d.
map.对比自然光照是否达标，决定补光时长与强度。: Compare natural light against the target to decide supplement duration and intensity.
map.实测平均 PPFD = 350 µmol/m²/s，冬季日照有效 10 小时。D: Measured avg PPFD = 350 μmol/m²/s, winter effective 10 h. DLI = 350 x 10 x 3600 / 1e6 = 12.6 mol/m²/d. Below tomato's 20, supplement to 20, i.e. add 7.4 mol in the supplement period.
map.DLI 和光照度（lux）能直接换算吗？: Can DLI and illuminance (lux) be directly converted?
map.不能直接换算，lux 含人眼权重，PPFD 是植物有效光合: No direct conversion; lux includes human-eye weighting, PPFD is plant-effective photosynthesis
map.密度（µmol/m²/s）。需用分光法或专用量子传感器测量 PPFD。: density (μmol/m²/s). PPFD must be measured by spectroradiometry or a dedicated quantum sensor.
map.一般不会因 DLI 过高伤苗，但强光伴随高温会引发光抑制。重点是『时长×强度』组: Generally no seedling damage from high DLI, but strong light with high temperature causes photoinhibition. The point is the duration x intensity combo; summer shading often matters more than adding light.
map.每日光积分（Daily Light Integral, DLI）是衡量植物一天内: Daily Light Integral (DLI) measures the total photosynthetically active radiation a plant receives per day, usually mol/m²/day. This tool helps greenhouse growers quickly estimate DLI and judge whether light meets crop needs.
map.输入 PAR 与光照时长即可得到 DLI: Enter PAR and light hours to get DLI
map.支持补光与自然光场景: Supports supplemental and natural light scenarios
